## Safety checklist

- [ ] Tests use mocks, fixtures, synthetic data, or emulators only.
- [ ] No production credentials, tokens, personal data, or service-account files are included.
- [ ] No pull-request workflow exposes secrets to contributor code.
- [ ] No live Yahoo mutation, real email delivery, or production Firebase access was performed.
- [ ] Security, privacy, migration, and rollback impact is documented when relevant.
